name: Scenario R: Starter-to-Growth Upsell Campaign
comments: Runs on the 20th of every month at 11:00 AM America/New_York (cron: 0 11 20 * *). Fetches all rows from the ActiveClients Google Sheet (env.ACTIVE_CLIENTS_SHEET_ID) and filters to tier=Starter clients. Iterates over each Starter client, calculates days_active from go_live_date, and flags upsell_ready = days_active >= 60. A router passes only upsell-ready clients downstream. For each eligible client, calls OpenRouter Claude Sonnet 4-6 to generate a personalized 3-paragraph upgrade email body, then sends that email to the client via Resend (white-labeled as 'Brian at [ClientName]'). A second Resend call sends Brian an internal upsell opportunity alert. Error handler sends a Resend alert to env.ADMIN_EMAIL on any failure. All secrets stored as env.VARIABLE_NAME. Timezone: America/New_York.

metadata.notes: Schedule trigger — runs on the 20th of every month at 11:00 AM America/New_York. Cron: 0 11 20 * *. No input data — fires the scenario to kick off the monthly Starter-to-Growth upsell sweep.

parameters.name: handleErrors
parameters.label: Evaluate all states as errors (except for 2xx and 3xx)

metadata.notes: Google Sheets HTTP GET — GET /v4/spreadsheets/{ACTIVE_CLIENTS_SHEET_ID}/values/ActiveClients. Returns all rows from the ActiveClients tab as a 2D array in response.data.values. Row 0 is the header row (client_name, email, tier, go_live_date, ...). Auth via Bearer env.GOOGLE_SHEETS_ACCESS_TOKEN. valueRenderOption=FORMATTED_VALUE so dates are returned as human-readable strings.

Iterator — loops over each data row in 2.data.values, skipping the header (row index 0) via slice(...; 1). Emits one bundle per client row. Expected column order: [0] client_name, [1] email, [2] tier, [3] go_live_date. Downstream modules (4–8) run once per client row.

SetVariable — extracts fields from the iterator bundle (module 3) and computes derived values. Sets: client_name (col 0), client_email (col 1), tier (col 2), go_live_date (col 3, raw string). Calculates days_active as ceiling of dateDifference(now, parseDate(go_live_date), 'days'). Sets upsell_ready = true when days_active >= 60, else false. Sets run_date (today formatted ET). The Router in module 5 reads 4.upsell_ready and 4.tier to decide whether to proceed.

Router — two routes. Route 1 (Upsell Ready): passes through when 4.tier == 'Starter' AND 4.upsell_ready == true. Proceeds to modules 6, 7, 8. Route 2 (Skip): matches when 4.upsell_ready == false; this branch terminates and the iterator advances to the next client. Only clients on the Starter plan with 60+ days active reach the email and alert modules.

parameters.name: handleErrors
parameters.label: Evaluate all states as errors (except for 2xx and 3xx)

metadata.notes: OpenRouter HTTP POST — model anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-6. Prompt: write a friendly 3-paragraph email to [client_name] who has been using AI chat automation for [days_active] days on Starter at $197/mo. Acknowledge great results. Suggest Growth at $397/mo (adds weekly digest, lead scoring, client health monitoring). Be genuine and never pushy. Return only the email body. max_tokens 500, temperature 0.7. Claude response is at 6.data.choices[0].message.content.

parameters.name: handleErrors
parameters.label: Evaluate all states as errors (except for 2xx and 3xx)

metadata.notes: Resend HTTP POST — sends personalized upgrade offer email to the client. White-labeled FROM 'Brian at [client_name] <env.RESEND_FROM_ADDRESS>'. TO: 4.client_email. Subject: 'You have outgrown Starter — here is what is next'. Body: Claude-generated 3-paragraph email (module 6). Plain text format keeps the email personal and avoids promotional spam filters.

parameters.label: Evaluate all states as errors (except for 2xx and 3xx)

metadata.notes: Resend HTTP POST — internal upsell alert to Brian. FROM env.CWI_ALERT_FROM_ADDRESS. TO env.ADMIN_EMAIL. Subject: 'Upsell email sent to [client_name] — [N] days active on Starter'. HTML body includes a styled table with client name, email, current plan (Starter $197/mo), days active, go-live date, upgrade target (Growth $397/mo), and the date the email was sent. Prompts Brian to follow up within 5 business days if no reply.

metadata.notes: Error Handler — Resend alert to env.ADMIN_EMAIL on any scenario failure. FROM env.CWI_ALERT_FROM_ADDRESS. Subject: '[ERROR] Scenario R Upsell Campaign Failed — [client_name]'. HTML body includes error message, failed module, timestamp (ET), client name, client email, days_active, go_live_date from module 4 to allow manual follow-up. handleErrors: false so this module itself does not recurse on error.

notes.content: Module 1: Schedule trigger — cron 0 11 20 * * — fires on the 20th of every month at 11:00 AM America/New_York.
Module 2: Google Sheets HTTP GET — /v4/spreadsheets/{ACTIVE_CLIENTS_SHEET_ID}/values/ActiveClients — returns all rows from the ActiveClients tab. Auth: Bearer env.GOOGLE_SHEETS_ACCESS_TOKEN.
Module 3: Iterator — loops over each data row in 2.data.values (skipping header row via slice). One bundle per client. Expected cols: [0] client_name, [1] email, [2] tier, [3] go_live_date.

Module 4: SetVariable — extracts client_name, client_email, tier, go_live_date. Calculates days_active (ceiling of dateDifference). Sets upsell_ready = true when days_active >= 60. Sets run_date (today ET).
Module 5: Router — Route 1 (Upsell Ready): tier == Starter AND upsell_ready == true → proceeds to modules 6, 7, 8. Route 2 (Skip): upsell_ready == false → terminates for that client.

Module 6: OpenRouter HTTP POST — anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-6 — generates a friendly 3-paragraph upgrade email body for client_name with days_active. Suggests Growth at $397/mo (weekly digest, lead scoring, client health monitoring). Returns only the email body.

Module 7: Resend HTTP POST — white-labeled client email. FROM 'Brian at [client_name] <env.RESEND_FROM_ADDRESS>'. TO: client email. Subject: 'You have outgrown Starter — here is what is next'. Body: Claude-generated email (module 6). Plain text.

Module 8: Resend HTTP POST — internal upsell alert to Brian. FROM env.CWI_ALERT_FROM_ADDRESS. TO env.ADMIN_EMAIL. Subject: 'Upsell email sent to [client_name] — [N] days active on Starter'. HTML table with client details and upgrade context.

Module 9: Error Handler — Resend alert to env.ADMIN_EMAIL on any failure. Includes error message, failed module, timestamp ET, client name, client email, days_active, go_live_date for manual follow-up.

environment_variables.ACTIVE_CLIENTS_SHEET_ID: Google Sheets spreadsheet ID for the ActiveClients workbook
environment_variables.GOOGLE_SHEETS_ACCESS_TOKEN: OAuth 2.0 access token (or service account token) with read access to the ActiveClients Google Sheet
environment_variables.OPENROUTER_API_KEY: OpenRouter API key for Claude access
environment_variables.OPENROUTER_REFERRER: HTTP-Referer header value for OpenRouter requests (e.g. https://cwiai.net)
environment_variables.RESEND_API_KEY: Resend API key for sending emails
environment_variables.RESEND_FROM_ADDRESS: Verified sender address for white-labeled client emails (e.g. brian@cwiai.net)
environment_variables.CWI_ALERT_FROM_ADDRESS: Verified sender address for internal CWI alerts (e.g. alerts@cwiai.net)
environment_variables.ADMIN_EMAIL: Brian's email address for internal upsell alerts and error notifications
